title: competitor-scan
summary: Structure a lightweight competitive scan without inventing benchmark numbers or campaign verdicts.

skill_metadata.name: competitor-scan
skill_metadata.description: Structure a lightweight competitive scan without inventing benchmark numbers or campaign verdicts.

applicability.scope: Qualitative positioning of a new RSI repository against other projects before acceptance evidence exists
applicability.prerequisites: A selected repository and readable public material from the alternatives; no benchmark run is required
applicability.input_contract: A target repository plus whatever the alternatives publish about what they optimize and how they prove it
applicability.produced_artifact: A short Markdown note covering problem, alternatives, differentiation, limits and open questions
failure_modes: Numeric comparison written without a PASS campaign in our own evidence tree
Third-party figure repeated as if reproduced under our RunSpec
Scan presented as a substitute for acceptance evidence
applicability.refusal_point: Refuses any numeric comparison not sourced from our own evidence/<campaign-id>/results/ with a PASS verdict

recommendations: Answer the four framing questions qualitatively first; the absence of a published claim contract is itself a finding.
Label every third-party number unverified unless it was reproduced under our RunSpec.
Close the note with open questions rather than a conclusion the evidence cannot support.
limitations: Produces positioning material only; it establishes no performance or quality result.
Third-party claim contracts are read from public material and may be incomplete.
skill_metadata.searchspace_not_applicable: SKILL.md §§ Frame, Rules and Deliverable produce a qualitative competitive comparison with evidence limits, not a hardware-resource decision or implementation mechanism.
